id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

buildId.description:
The ID of the {@link Jarvis.Build} that this lambda belongs to.
If this is a platform lambda, this field will be empty.

hookStep.description: The name of the {@link Jarvis.Step} that the custom step should hook into

hookStrategy.description: Whether the custom step should be a blocking step or an async step

packageName.description:
The name of the package the lambda should be run in.
If package name is provided, the {@link packageVersion} has to be provided too.

packageVersion.description:
The version of the package the lambda should be run in.
If {@link #packageName} is provided, the version has to be provided too.
